msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all anatomical sites lined by Simple Squamous Epithelium: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Endothelium of blood and lymph vessels
B) Mesothelium of pleura and pericardium
C) Parietal layer of Bowman's capsule
D) Alveolar air sacs of lungs
answers: A) Endothelium of blood and lymph vessels
B) Mesothelium of pleura and pericardium
C) Parietal layer of Bowman's capsule
D) Alveolar air sacs of lungs
msqs.explanation: Simple squamous lines endothelium, mesothelium, Bowman's capsule, and lung alveoli.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all anatomical locations lined by Simple Cuboidal Epithelium: (Select all that apply)
options: C) Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT) of nephron
answers: C) Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT) of nephron
msqs.explanation: Simple cuboidal lines thyroid follicles, gland ducts, renal PCT, and ovary surface.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all cell junction types connecting adjacent epithelial cells: (Select all that apply)
msqs.explanation: Epithelial cell junctions include Tight, Adherens, Desmosomes, and Gap junctions.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all locations containing Non-Keratinized Stratified Squamous Epithelium: (Select all that apply)
options: E) Dry outer epidermis of skin
msqs.explanation: Non-keratinized stratified squamous lines moist surfaces: mouth, oesophagus, vagina, cornea.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all characteristics of Transitional Epithelium (Urothelium): (Select all that apply)
options: C) High stretch capability without cell separation
D) Lines urinary bladder, ureters, and renal pelvis
E) Keratinized dead cell stratum corneum
answers: C) High stretch capability without cell separation
D) Lines urinary bladder, ureters, and renal pelvis
msqs.explanation: Urothelium is a distensible compound epithelium with umbrella cells lining the urinary tract.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all specialized modifications of epithelial cell surface: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Microvilli forming brush border for absorption
B) Motile Kino-cilia for fluid propulsion
answers: A) Microvilli forming brush border for absorption
B) Motile Kino-cilia for fluid propulsion
msqs.explanation: Epithelial surface modifications include microvilli, motile cilia, stereocilia, and keratin.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all specialized glandular epithelial modes of secretion: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Merocrine / Eccrine (Exocytosis without cell loss)
B) Apocrine (Apical cytoplasm loss e.g. mammary gland)
C) Holocrine (Complete cell disintegration e.g. sebaceous gland)
answers: A) Merocrine / Eccrine (Exocytosis without cell loss)
B) Apocrine (Apical cytoplasm loss e.g. mammary gland)
C) Holocrine (Complete cell disintegration e.g. sebaceous gland)
msqs.explanation: Glandular modes of secretion: Merocrine, Apocrine, Holocrine, and Endocrine.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all organs containing Pseudostratified Ciliated Columnar Epithelium: (Select all that apply)
msqs.explanation: Pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium lines trachea, bronchi, nasopharynx, and auditory tube.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all locations containing Germinal Epithelium producing gametes: (Select all that apply)
msqs.explanation: Germinal cuboidal epithelium lines seminiferous tubules and ovary surface for gametogenesis.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all functions of Gap Junctions (Nexus) between epithelial cells: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Intercellular passage of small ions (Ca2+, Na+)
B) Passage of signaling second messengers (cAMP)
C) Direct electrical and metabolic cell coupling
E) Mechanical anchoring of keratin intermediate filaments
answers: A) Intercellular passage of small ions (Ca2+, Na+)
B) Passage of signaling second messengers (cAMP)
C) Direct electrical and metabolic cell coupling
msqs.explanation: Gap junctions allow passage of ions and second messengers for electrical/metabolic coupling. Desmosomes provide mechanical anchor.
